description: List every Salesforce org bound to this solet, read from the plugin's vault index (<solet>.salesforce_plugin.orgs_index): alias, org_id (18 characters), username, target_org (what the sf CLI is called with), pinned instance_host, org_type (production, sandbox or scratch), is_dev_hub, login_method (cli, web, jwt, sfdx_url, access_token, scratch_create or sandbox_create), dev_hub_org_id for a scratch org, the names (never the values) of the vault secrets its login uses, and which org is the default. Also reports whether the single salesforce_org address-book entry that predates multi-org support still awaits migration (it is migrated by the first call of any verb). No Salesforce call is made. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: See which Salesforce orgs this solet is connected to: production orgs, sandboxes, scratch orgs and Dev Hubs, with each org's alias, org id, username, instance host and how it logged in, plus which org is the default when a request does not name one. Use before choosing an org for any Salesforce request.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: orgs (each with org_id, alias, target_org, username, instance_host, org_type, is_dev_hub, login_method, dev_hub_org_id, jwt_key_secret, secret_names, migrated_from_legacy and default), count, default_org (the default org's alias, or empty), legacy_pending_migration (true, false, or null when the address book could not be read) and advisories when something could not be read.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show each org by alias with its type, username and whether it is the default or a Dev Hub. Secret names identify vault entries the operator stored; they are not secrets themselves, and their values are never shown.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read the bound Salesforce orgs from the vault index.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: vault_service_not_available: the plugin has no vault proxy. sf.org_registry_failed: the vault could not say whether the index exists, or the index could not be read or is not valid JSON.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: A vault failure is a platform problem: check the vault service status. An empty list means no org is bound yet: bind one with bind_org (an org the sf CLI is logged in to) or log in with login.
